VIABLE_NICHE_FOUND.name: Band-Dwell Control
VIABLE_NICHE_FOUND.problem: RL/control: drive a LATENT readiness state into a narrow BAND, HOLD under timing uncertainty, then MANDATORILY WITHDRAW interventions before an uncertain exogenous TRIGGER (overshoot-penalized). Not reducible to set-point tracking, titration-RL maintenance, or standard constrained MDPs.
VIABLE_NICHE_FOUND.honest_calibration: This is a PROBLEM-FORMULATION novelty (the whole point of the pivot): novel at the INTERSECTION of known pieces (band-tracking, latent-state RL, mandatory-cessation, uncertain-horizon MDPs), independently judged unformulated + useful. A real but reviewer-debatable kind of novelty (a new problem class, not a new theorem). Next step = formalize the MDP, prove the withdrawal asymmetry is not a standard CMDP constraint, demo on anesthesia-emergence or T1D simulators.

framing_comparison_answer.newest_ML (epochs 1-4): ~0/8 undone -> 0 VIABLE in 4 epochs (prior-art saturation by construction)
framing_comparison_answer.Framing A mature-ML: 4/4 generator-undone, but viability -> mostly SEED_ONLY: mature-ML fixes 'undone' (crowd moved on) but the undone combos are often undone-BECAUSE-niche (not useful-enough) or thin over a known general technique. Improves the input, does not by itself yield VIABLE.
framing_comparison_answer.Framing B life->new-problem: 4/4 generator-unformulated; viability -> 1 clear VIABLE (B1) + SEED/borderline others. The PIVOT (novelty in the PROBLEM, not in beating a crowded method) is what broke the >=0 VIABLE rate.
framing_comparison_answer.conclusion: The first-principles diagnosis was CORRECT: the broken part was the ML-axis INPUT, not the checkers. Both new framings escape prior-art saturation; Framing B (new-problem) is the one that produced a VIABLE because it makes novelty=problem-formulation, which is structurally harder to pre-empt than novelty=better-method. Mature-ML (Framing A) reliably fixes 'undone' but must be paired with a genuinely useful target to reach VIABLE.
